text: Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2020 earnings call.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
text: Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 544 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
text: We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
text: I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
text: Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2020.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
text: We delivered record revenue of $26.8 billion this quarter, representing 20% year-over-year growth.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
text: Revenue guidance of $26.8 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Operating income reached $4.9 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 158 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
